body:
Burn-down complete (--status approved). Ready set is empty; no open PRs.

Completed (10 PRs merged, integrated, auto-bumped to Completed):
  carried-in wave (from the relaunch): TASK-1165 #1566, BUG-772 #1567, BUG-771 #1568
  wave 1: TASK-994 #1569, TASK-1013 #1570, TASK-1009 #1571, TASK-1167 #1572
  wave 2: TASK-1019 #1573, TASK-1014 #1574
  wave 3: TASK-1022 #1575

Sequencing note (worth your attention): the four TASK-0429 children (TASK-1013/1014/1019/1022) all extend the autopilot audit record TASK-1018 just landed, so I tagged them into a serialize group rather than co-fanning them. STORY-614's collapse_serialize_groups then did the sequencing itself -- it held the group members back and released each one as its partner merged. I did not have to hand-manage the wave shape; the substrate did. Worth knowing the enforcement is real and working.

Caveats worth noting: the post-wave integrated-main verify was a COMPILE check (cargo build -p aida-cli) after each of the three waves, per the skill -- not a full test run on merged main. Each PR's own CI (Build ubuntu-latest) was green before merge. Also: TASK-1013/1014/1019/1022 all had EMPTY description fields -- the title carried the whole intent. The implementers worked from the parent TASK-0429 plus the preceding siblings' diffs. That worked here because the siblings landed in order and each diff taught the next, but a spec whose only specification is its title is thin ground for an unattended drain.

Held / awaiting sign-off: none held by me. The gate reports VIS-1, TASK-1169, TASK-1131 as pickable-but-unqueued -- they need your bless before any drain touches them.

Left for manual merge: none.

Parked (the gate's set, unchanged, 11): TASK-735, TASK-751 (deferred:on-demand); TASK-749 (deferred:future-rbac); TASK-892 (deferred:until-projects-toml-consumed); TASK-1136/1137/1138/1139 (BlockedBy unsatisfied); EPIC-44 (epic -- decompose first); STORY-687, STORY-688 (deferred:cockpit-phase2).

Worktrees not pruned: 3 LOCKED agent worktrees from a prior session, all at d9f9eceb8 -- agent-a942df7439695a8aa, agent-ab76dad2f2712ef43, agent-ada058a96e1aba25f. Not mine and not tied to a merged spec, so I left them per the prune guards. Worth a look if no agent still holds them.

Filed during the drain: TASK-149 (promoted from finding TASK-1-125) -- aida burndown plan folds serialize-HELD specs into awaiting_signoff, which reads as "the advisor has not blessed this" when the spec is in fact queued and blessed and merely deferred to a later wave. Two distinct states share one label; the fix is a separate serialize_held key in the JSON. I hit this live: TASK-1022 showed queued in aida queue list and "actionable -- ready" in aida why, while burndown plan filed it under awaiting_signoff.

Housekeeping: rebuilt the release binary at the end -- it had drifted behind HEAD mid-drain and is now an exact match at 74ef6a25.
